mapper.select: SELECT a.assignment_id,a.project_id,a.document_id,a.document_revision,a.task_id,a.task_revision,a.assignee_id,a.return_id,r.operation_id FROM document_revision_return_assignment a JOIN document_revision_return r ON r.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND r.project_id=a.project_id AND r.return_id=a.return_id AND r.document_id=a.document_id AND r.document_revision=a.document_revision AND r.task_id=a.task_id AND r.task_revision=a.task_revision AND r.assignee_id=a.assignee_id WHERE a.assignee_id=#{userId} AND a.assignment_id > #{after} ORDER BY a.assignment_id LIMIT #{fetchLimit} FOR UPDATE
SELECT task_id,current_revision,status,revision FROM task_head WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND task_id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT m.tenant_id,m.member_id,m.user_id,m.status,m.valid_from,m.valid_to,m.revision FROM tenant_member m WHERE m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM identity_binding i WHERE i.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND i.user_id=m.user_id AND i.status='ACTIVE') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM permission_grant g WHERE g.tenant_id=m.tenant_id AND g.subject_id=m.user_id AND g.action='task.read' AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (g.valid_to IS NULL OR g.valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND ((g.resource_kind='ENTERPRISE' AND g.project_id IS NULL AND g.resource_id=m.tenant_id) OR (g.resource_kind='PROJECT' AND g.project_id=#{projectId} AND g.resource_id=#{projectId}) OR (g.resource_kind='TASK' AND g.project_id=#{projectId} AND (g.resource_id IS NULL OR g.resource_id=#{taskId})))) ORDER BY m.user_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('record_sha256',SHA2(CAST(JSON_OBJECT('revision',CAST(c.revision AS CHAR), 'scope_manifest_id',c.scope_manifest_id,'rule_manifest',c.rule_manifest,'input_watermarks',c.input_watermarks, 'result_ref',c.result_ref,'coverage_hash',coverage.sha256,'findings_hash',findings.sha256) AS CHAR),256), 'check_id',c.check_id,'status',c.status,'input_sha256',c.input_sha256, 'rule_manifest_id',c.rule_manifest_id,'evidence_watermark',CAST(c.evidence_watermark AS CHAR), 'issue_watermark',CAST(c.issue_watermark AS CHAR),'invalidation_reason',c.invalidation_reason, 'coverage_artifact_id',c.coverage_artifact_id,'findings_artifact_id',c.findings_artifact_id, 'record_complete',CAST(IF(c.status='SUCCEEDED' AND c.invalidation_reason IS NULL AND c.evidence_watermark=#{evidenceWatermark} AND c.issue_watermark=#{issueWatermark} AND c.result_ref IS NOT NULL AND coverage.artifact_id IS NOT NULL AND findings.artifact_id IS NOT NULL, 'true','false') AS JSON)) AS CHAR) FROM check_run c LEFT JOIN artifact coverage ON coverage.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND coverage.project_key=c.project_key AND coverage.artifact_id=c.coverage_artifact_id LEFT JOIN artifact findings ON findings.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND findings.project_key=c.project_key AND findings.artifact_id=c.findings_artifact_id WHERE c.project_id=#{projectId} AND c.target_kind='DOCUMENT' AND c.target_id=#{documentId} AND c.target_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY c.check_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.review_id FROM review_decision r WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_revision=#{documentRevision} AND r.decision='CONFIRM' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM review_invalidation i WHERE i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.project_id=r.project_id AND i.review_id=r.review_id) ORDER BY r.review_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT o.operation_id,o.request_sha256,o.state,o.http_status,o.response_ref,o.target_id,o.schema_version,o.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM document_revision_return r JOIN operation_record o ON o.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND o.operation_id=r.operation_id AND o.subject_id=r.actor_id AND o.created_by=r.actor_id AND r.created_by=r.actor_id WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.return_id=#{returnId} AND o.operation_name='DOCUMENT-RETURN-FOR-REVISION-1' FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref,target_id,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256 FROM operation_record WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='DOCUMENT-RETURN-FOR-REVISION-1' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event WHERE aggregate_id=#{documentId} AND aggregate_revision=#{resultingDocument} AND event_type='document.returned_for_revision'
SELECT signature_id FROM signature_record WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY signature_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT grant_id,subject_id,project_id,resource_kind,resource_id,action,`condition`,status,valid_from,valid_to, basis_version,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,revision FROM permission_grant WHERE subject_id=#{assigneeId} AND action=#{targetAction} AND status='ACTIVE' AND valid_from <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY grant_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.assignment_id,r.return_id,r.operation_id,r.canonical_request,r.request_sha256,r.canonical_receipt,r.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM document_revision_return r JOIN document_revision_return_assignment a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.return_id=r.return_id AND r.created_by=r.actor_id AND r.schema_version='1.0.0' AND a.created_by=r.actor_id AND a.created_at=r.created_at AND a.classification=r.classification AND a.schema_version=r.schema_version AND a.schema_manifest_sha256=r.schema_manifest_sha256 WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.document_revision=#{documentRevision} ORDER BY r.created_at,r.return_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE

SELECT a.assignment_id,r.return_id,r.operation_id,r.canonical_request,r.request_sha256,r.canonical_receipt,r.schema_manifest_sha256 FROM document_revision_return r JOIN document_revision_return_assignment a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.return_id=r.return_id AND r.created_by=r.actor_id AND r.schema_version='1.0.0' AND a.created_by=r.actor_id AND a.created_at=r.created_at AND a.classification=r.classification AND a.schema_version=r.schema_version AND a.schema_manifest_sha256=r.schema_manifest_sha256 WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.operation_id=#{operationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(JSON_OBJECT('return_id',r.return_id,'document_id',r.document_id,'document_revision',r.document_revision, 'decision',r.decision,'reason',r.reason,'actor_id',r.actor_id,'assignee_id',r.assignee_id, 'decided_at',DATE_FORMAT(r.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'),'baseline_manifest',JSON_EXTRACT(r.canonical_request,'$.request.basis'), 'assignment',JSON_OBJECT('assignment_id',a.assignment_id,'kind','DOCUMENT_RETURN_FOR_REVISION','return_id',a.return_id, 'document_id',a.document_id,'document_revision',a.document_revision,'task_id',a.task_id,'task_revision',a.task_revision, 'assignee_id',a.assignee_id,'reason',r.reason,'status',a.status,'revision',CAST(a.revision AS CHAR), 'created_at',DATE_FORMAT(a.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ'))) AS CHAR) FROM document_revision_return r JOIN document_revision_return_assignment a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.project_id=r.project_id AND a.return_id=r.return_id AND a.document_id=r.document_id AND a.document_revision=r.document_revision AND a.task_id=r.task_id AND a.task_revision=r.task_revision AND a.assignee_id=r.assignee_id AND r.created_by=r.actor_id AND r.schema_version='1.0.0' AND a.created_by=r.actor_id AND a.created_at=r.created_at AND a.classification=r.classification AND a.schema_version=r.schema_version AND a.schema_manifest_sha256=r.schema_manifest_sha256 WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.return_id=#{returnId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN i.reason_code='DOCUMENT_RETURNED_FOR_REVISION' AND i.classification=r.classification AND d.review_id IS NOT NULL AND d.decision='CONFIRM' AND d.document_revision=r.document_revision THEN i.review_id ELSE 'INVALID_INVALIDATION' END FROM document_revision_return r JOIN review_invalidation i ON i.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND i.project_id=r.project_id AND i.trigger_version=r.document_revision AND i.created_by=r.actor_id AND i.created_at=r.created_at LEFT JOIN review_decision d ON d.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND d.project_id=i.project_id AND d.review_id=i.review_id WHERE r.project_id=#{projectId} AND r.document_id=#{documentId} AND r.return_id=#{returnId} ORDER BY i.review_id LIMIT 101 FOR UPDATE
